cues.text: Bright industrial lights blaze intensely within a metal framework structure overhead.
Futuristic city skyline glows at dawn.
On screen: 40 YEARS LATER.
A human brain sits on a white platform surrounded by glowing pink circular light rings.
The flying ship hovers above the sprawling city below.
Inside the flying ship, silhouetted figures stand at control panels.
A hand holds an open newspaper.
Barley peers through rifle scope.
Flying ship descends lower.
The flying ship continues descending toward the residential buildings below.
The old man lies beneath metal framework as Barley aims downward.
The old man stands in a high rooftop shelter as the flying ship looms outside the windows beyond.
Rope lies coiled.
The old man stands alone in the industrial space, gripping the thick rope as he looks toward the machinery.
Old man walks indoors.
Old man enters lit room.
The old man stands with arms raised in the glowing light.
Others appear.
Man grabs old man's arm.
A soldier in brown pulls the old man toward the city.
Stone pillar stands in overgrown courtyard.
Young man walks forward.
Young man stops on urban street lined with metal railings.
Young man gazes at canal.
The Captain sits indoors.
The Captain manipulates glowing holographic controls with his hands.
Thom stands facing a woman with light brown hair in a city square.
Thom looks away from the woman in the city square.
Soldiers in tactical gear descend.
Flying ship fires pink energy beams.
Blackboard displays writing.
Man reacts in shock.
Young man holds gun to mouth.
A man with curly hair and glasses stares ahead in a control room lit by blue and purple light.
The Captain's mechanical eyepiece glows red as a woman watches from behind him.
Curly-haired technician operates glowing device.
Barley aims his scoped rifle across a sunlit rooftop toward the city.
Flying ship descends.
Hands in dark sleeves lower the flying ship onto a detailed miniature model of city buildings, positioning it carefully over the scaled structures below.
Inside the flying ship, soldiers in tactical gear crouch among equipment and machinery.
Thom, a young man with light brown hair in a cream shirt, sits at controls beside another man, both focused on operating machinery in front of them.
A man in a blue and yellow jacket lies on the ground in shadow.
The flying ship descends toward a narrow city street below.
The giant robot raises its arm.
Robot's fist descends.
Man's face bleeds from impact.
The old man stands on a bridge facing the giant robot.
Robot's arm pulls back.
The giant robot's massive fist swings forward toward the old man on the bridge.
Technician watches monitors intently.
The old man stands before the giant robot's massive torso, reaching toward its metal chest as the fist descends toward him.
The old man sits in a cluttered room while a young man stands nearby watching.
The old man gestures toward soldiers.
Robot's hands close.
Giant robot's glowing hands grip a weapon.
Giant robot raises the weapon toward the sky.
Giant robot explodes into fragments.
Debris falls through air.
